title: ^RESEARCH METHODS IN PSYCHOLOGICAL SCIENCE
description: Explores the principles of research design in the field of psychology. Emphasizes ability to identify research questions, formulate hypotheses to test those questions, and design a research study to test hypotheses. Develops ability to apply statistics and draw conclusions about research questions based on research design choices.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (PSY 298 or 298H) or ((PSY 201, 201H, 201Z or 201HZ) and (PSY 202, 202H, 202Z or 202HZ) and ST 352).
A minimum grade of C- is required in PSY 298, PSY 298H, PSY 201, PSY 201H, PSY 201Z, PSY 201HZ, PSY 202, PSY 202H, PSY 202Z, PSY 202HZ and ST 352.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.
